name: zebra-design-system
description: Build product UI with the Zebra Design System: zebra-figma-to-code, zebra-build-ui, zebra-prototype, zebra-onboard-project, zebra-handoff, zebra-ux-patterns and zebra-ux-audit skills, the UX pattern pack, the per-component usage catalog, the system's design voice, and commands for project setup and component lookup.
